summary: P5a builds the proof deploy repo the r1 F1 ruling asked for, and it holds up under test: the gate is green on b265fa3 (previously unverified), the hook's clone/backend/apply contract matches presync/ line for line, the apply-failure precondition was witnessed stopping at plan time before any create, and two acceptance-critical gate assertions go red on their own mutation. Two advisory findings, neither blocking: one gate assertion a commented-out backend block satisfies, and an operator keystroke missing from the close-out's drill runbook.

findings.summary: check_terraform_contract regex-searches raw .tf text, so a commented-out `backend "http" {}` keeps the whole gate green while `terraform init` falls back to local state with only a warning (mutation witnessed).

close-out A4's drill runbook names the registry entry, the webhook and the deletions but not pushing ProofDeploy to origin/main, which still has no refs — until it does, every keystroke A4 lists is inert.
